notes.title: Easter Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109622/1a5cdbf63ebd88173d633c25fd346ad90ad695a8.pngPatch Notes:
Added:
- Season II of the game content has begun !
- Easter Event is now available !
- Ema Draw is now available !
- Season II of Ranked PVP is now available !
- A new Skill Training is now available !
- A new zodiac pet - Zodiac Pisces is now available !
- New Legendary Skills are now available in Black Merchant !
- Black Merchant system changes.
- Combat system changes.
- Clan Shop system changes.
- Pet weapons and back items are now available !
- Easter Event's Ranking has begun !
- Point Rewards are back with brand new rewards !
- PVP Shop is now available !
- A new Emblem+ feature, item favorites are now available !
- A new Emblem+ feature, gear search is now available !
- A new deal has been added in Valentine's Event !
- Easter deals are now available !
- More effects show their percentage now on combat !


Removed:
- Halloween event has ended !
- Thanksgiving Event has ended !
- Christmas Battles have ended !


Changes:
- The Lightning Shop NPC has been replaced.
- Easter Village is now available, in place of Christmas Village.
- Easter UI is now available, in place of Christmas UI.
- Village shaders are now available in the entire game !
- You can now claim the unreleased rewards from Christmas Event !
- You can now preview all legendary skills in Black Merchant !
- You can now preview the combat effects of enemies in battles !
- Clan Shop UI has been reworked.
- Clan Shop now supports new item categories for future rewards !
- PVP Shop UI has been reworked.


Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue with the lock icon for level requirements in Hunting House.
- Fixed an issue with the lock icon for level requirements  in Eudemon Garden.
- Fixed an issue with the lock icon for level requirements  in Soul Hunt.
- Fixed an issue with claiming some of the rewards in Christmas Battle Progress.
- Fixed an issue with claiming some of the rewards in Global Battle Progress.

notes.title: Thanksgiving Event
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109622/8b194bf8c7515a2551cb1f5e0bc4e5bdff89fd85.png

We’re excited to announce the latest update is now live! Here’s what’s new and improved:
    🆕 New Content            🍂 Thanksgiving Event: Celebrate the season with festive activities, rewards, and surprises!        🖤 Black Friday Exchange: Enjoy limited-time offers and exclusive in-game bonuses!        💻 Cyber Monday Packages: Special deals are now available—don’t miss out!        🐞 Bug Fixes            🔧 Fixed an issue with the Arena S12 skill.        
Enjoy the update and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Halloween Event is now here!
notes.content:
🎃 Halloween Patch Notes 🎃
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109622/e7ec40eafd89df059cf5f7942c24c85901aca782.png
Join the seasonal celebration with exclusive Halloween-themed activities, rewards, and challenges!
🏆 Event Rankings & Exclusive Items!
Compete in the event rankings for a chance to earn special items and showcase your Halloween spirit.
🎃 Village Transformation
Experience a new seasonal look for your village, fully decorated with Halloween flair to immerse you in the spooky atmosphere.
📦 Halloween Skill Training & Packages
New skill training options and Halloween-themed packages are now available to help you gear up and improve your skills during the event.
⚙️ Performance Upgrades
Significant optimizations for improved performance, especially on mobile devices—enjoy a smoother gaming experience across all platforms!

Happy Halloween & Good Luck in the Rankings! 🎃
